Subject: Nomination: Partner promo credits for CloudBridge cohort

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well — CloudBridge is kicking off its next accelerator cohort (starts July 1) and we’d like to nominate a short list of early-stage customers for Redwood promotional credits as part of our joint benefits package. The cohort includes 12 teams working on LLM-powered developer tools and data platforms.

Can Redwood allocate promotional credits (recommended: $1,000 USD equivalent per company, redeemable for hosted inference usage) for this cohort? We’ve attached the cohort roster and a one-page program brief.

Key asks:
- Confirm whether Redwood can approve partner-sourced credits for cohort participants
- If approved, provide voucher codes or a marketplace credit bundle and an expiration window (recommended: 90 days)
- Any guardrails (per-company caps, disallowed use cases) we should communicate to the cohort

If helpful, happy to hop on a 20-min call this week to walk through the roster.

Thanks —
Elena Park
Partnerships, AcceleratorX (CloudBridge)
elena@acceleratorx.com

Marissa, looping you for partner program alignment and whether Marketplace channel credits are the preferred delivery mechanism.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Promo credit issuance for CloudBridge cohort

Hi Elena — great to confirm. Redwood will issue a bundle of 12x $1,000 promotional credits, redeemable on the Redwood hosted API, with a 90-day expiry from issuance. We’ve attached the set of voucher codes and a short redemption guide for cohort teams.

Quick notes you can share with the founders:
- Each team receives one voucher code (one-time use) worth $1,000 USD equivalent.
- Credits apply to generation and embedding tokens on Redwood hosted models only; cannot be used against Dedicated or Private deployments.
- Codes expire 90 days after issuance; unused credit does not roll over.
- Any suspected abuse will be paused and reviewed with AcceleratorX.

Attachments: promo-voucher-ACCX-2026-06.pdf (pdf, 8KB) — contains 12 single-use codes and redemption instructions.

If you’d like, we can do a joint 30-min onboarding on Monday 2026-06-16 at 10am PT to walk founders through onboarding and best practices for cost-efficient inference.

Thanks and excited to support the cohort —
Jonas Weber
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
